title: Genuine GQ point-line dual every-fixed-line all-h D6 expected floor

quantifiers.domain: integer h>=1, s=2^h, genuine original W(3,s)
any fixed complete ORIGINAL line-source globally injective physical unordered pair-label assignment
one independently uniformly sampled COMPLETE globally injected original point map shared over all original source Q

statement: By genuine W(3,2^h) point/line incidence duality, for every h>=1 and every fixed complete global ORIGINAL line assignment g, E_f[D6(f,g)|g]>=s^6/98304 for uniformly random ONE full globally injected point map f. This separately reverses fixed and averaged source types; it neither averages both sides nor establishes inf_(f,g) D6 or S_s.
external_dependencies: Genuine GQ W(3,2^h) point-line source self-duality, with original incidence-ID and physical C6 positional matching preserved.
limitations: At h>=3 AA4RCYC stronger dual 1/8 bound remains available.
No all-f,g adversarial positive lower is implied.
Cannot transfer uncritically to non-self-dual source incidence systems.
falsification_boundary: The original GQ duality must preserve the exact same-six-column D6 acceptance criterion and type-separated global injections.
